Name: Sam Thornton
Bio: After serving as Vice President last year, Sam is thrilled to step into the role of ELC Co-President. Beyond ELC, his campus involvement includes the Enable prosthetics club, hosting a WVFI podcast, and playing guitar for a student band. In his free time, he enjoys baking and wood carving, and is training for his first Ironman.

Name: Kyle Brown
Bio: Kyle Brown is the Vice President for ELC. He has been on ELC/FYEC for the past two years, and it has been a ton of fun! Outside of the classroom, he loves to do any competitive event, from sports to games, and hang out with his friends.

Name: Lauren Starr
Bio: Lauren Starr is a four-year member who has served as Treasurer and on FYEC. Originally from Pittsburgh, PA, she currently lives in Grojean Hall. For fun, Lauren enjoys watching football and spending too much time at the dining halls with friends.
